The GitHub repo browser-use/browser-use hosts that library, and community comments note its large GitHub star count, so the core agent source is publicly readable. missing for 10: explicit naming of the license (e.g. MIT) in the evidence, and clarity on whether the Cloud agent/browser infrastructure source is also open or only the Python library.
